orchestrator_output.reformulated_query: Overview of subjects and curriculum support available for CBSE school classes
orchestrator_output.text_narration:
• Chaduvu Guru provides complete learning support for Indian school students from Classes 6 to 10 under NCERT, CBSE, ICSE, and State Board standards.

• Key subjects covered include Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology), Mathematics, and Social Studies (History, Civics, Geography, Economics).

• You can ask doubts about textbook concepts, step-by-step problem solutions, chapter summaries, historical timelines, and scientific processes.
